thread:
alex: Heads up, unexpected family emergency — I need to drop out of tonight's primary shift. Can't access laptop for the next ~6hrs. Sorry everyone. :disappointed:

maya: Ack. Thanks for the heads up. Are you able to handoff anything in-flight? current pager/runs?

alex: I'm on one active P1 for inference-queue latency, but I just paged into the bridge and left notes. Can't stay on bridge though. Notes: `runbook/inference-queue -> check hot-shard, restart worker if backlog > 5000`, dc-us-west cluster.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service inference-queue (P1) — latency above threshold. Bridge: https://redwood/bridges/12345 — Triggered at 1732000123

jamie: @maya I'm available to take primary if you want me to. I can pick up the bridge and follow alex's notes.

maya: @jamie please take primary. @riley please patch me in as oncall-manager. jamie, confirm you can reach the bridge and run the restart if needed.

jamie: On it. Joining bridge now. I see the backlog at ~5.8k and sustained 95p latency 1.2s. Running quick check: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide` -> looks like a single worker node at 90% CPU.

ben: I can look at the node from infra side, might be noisy neighbor on that host. If you need a node drain/rotate say the word.

jamie: Before draining, I'll try scaling the deployment one replica: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=3` — doing that now.

alex: Thanks. If scale doesn't help in 3-4min, escalate to node drain. Sorry again for the handoff chaos.

jamie: Replica scale sent. Watching queue. If tokens don't clear in 3 mins, i'll escalate to infra for node drain.

incident-bot: Scale event detected: deployment inference-worker scaled from 2 -> 3 replicas at 1732000254 (automated event).

jamie: Nice— backlog falling to 3.2k, latency improving. Keep eye on error rates.

lee: Support here. Any customer-facing impacts? Which accounts were affected?

jamie: Latency spike affected all low-priority requests; no 5xxs observed yet. Primary affected route is `/v1/generate` on inference-queue. No active customer escalations so far.

riley: Good triage. @ben hold off on node drain unless backlog doesn't clear in 6 more mins. Also ping account team if we see sustained degradation >15m.

cory: FYI, there was a deploy earlier today that touched scheduling. I'm watching for regressions. If spike returns after a few minutes, could be deploy fallout.

jamie: Backlog now ~600, 95p latency ~220ms. Looks stable. I'm continuing monitoring for 10 more mins then will mark incident as mitigated.

maya: Thanks jamie. Quick note on paging rules while we're all here: if primary drops unexpectedly we follow this sequence — 1) primary tries to handoff, 2) secondary paged immediately if primary unavailable, 3) if unresolved after 5m page SRE lead, 4) if P0/P1 unresolved after 10m escalate to oncall-manager, 5) notify account owner for any customer impact >10m. Please keep these in mind.

jamie: Confirm I was paged as secondary and took over within 90s. No need to escalate.

riley: Noted. Also remember runbook pointer: `docs/runbooks/inference-queue.md` — steps 1-4 are quick triage (check backlog, scale, restart worker, node drain). Use the `incident` label when creating follow-up ticket.

ben: Thanks. Node host looked noisy but scale fixed it. I'll keep it under watch and file infra follow-up: INC-7893.

lee: I'll send a short notice to account team saying we observed latency spike, mitigated, no customer-facing errors, will follow up if anything else.

jamie: Marking incident mitigated in bridge at 1732000650. Leaving notes & timeline.

incident-bot: Incident mitigation logged for inference-queue (P1) — mitigated at 1732000650 — duration ~6m.

maya: Closing loop: jamie — thanks for picking up. alex — hope everything's ok. riley — can you confirm escalation policy wording for next week's oncall doc update? I want to add explicit timings and manager contact flow.

riley: Yup I'll update the oncall doc with explicit timing, add manager rotation contacts, and push a short blurb to the oncall channel.

alex: Appreciate everyone. I'll sync with my backup for next shift so this doesn't recur.

jamie: Quick suggestion for doc: include a checklist for last-minute handoffs: minimal notes to leave, bridge URL, CLI commands to try, and who to page for infra. Small template would save time.

maya: Good idea. I'll draft a template and post it in #eng-oncall later today. :thumbsup:

lee: Thanks team — notifying accounts.

cory: I'll keep an eye on post-deploy metrics and ping if I see a recurrence.

maya: Thread summary: primary dropped unexpectedly, secondary covered, scale mitigated, no customer errors, infra follow-up INC-7893, oncall doc update planned. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
